title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.00547v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unified Multimodal Large Models (UMLMs) integrate understanding and generation capabilities within a single architecture. While unified architectures expand multimodal capabilities, their safety implications remain important yet underexplored. Existing safety benchmarks predominantly focus on isolated understanding or generation tasks, failing to evaluate the holistic safety of UMLMs when handling diverse tasks under a unified framework. To address this, we introduce Uni-SafeBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring a taxonomy of six major safety categories across seven task types. To ensure rigorous assessment, we develop Uni-Judger, a framework that effectively decouples contextual safety from intrinsic safety. Based on comprehensive evaluations across Uni-SafeBench, we find that the original safety alignment of the underlying LLM is not consistently preserved in current unified models. translated_title: 统一是否以安全为代价？Uni-SafeBench：面向统一多模态大模型的安全基准
translated_abstract: 统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）在单一架构中整合了理解与生成能力。虽然统一架构扩展了多模态能力，但其安全性影响仍然重要且未被充分探索。现有安全基准主要聚焦于孤立的理解或生成任务，未能评估UMLMs在统一框架下处理多样任务时的整体安全性。为解决这一问题，我们引入了Uni-SafeBench，一个全面的基准，涵盖六个主要安全类别和七种任务类型。为确保严格评估，我们开发了Uni-Judger，一个有效解耦上下文安全与内在安全的框架。基于对Uni-SafeBench的全面评估，我们发现当前统一模型中底层大语言模型的原始安全对齐并未得到一致保持。此外，开源UMLMs表现出较低的安全水平。
tldr: 本文提出了Uni-SafeBench基准和Uni-Judger评估框架，系统揭示了统一多模态大模型在整合理解与生成能力时，其底层大语言模型的安全对齐常被削弱，尤其是开源模型安全水平较低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Uni-SafeBench and Uni-Judger, revealing that unified multimodal large models often weaken the original safety alignment of their underlying LLMs, with open-source models showing particularly low safety levels.
